title: No immediate bail for Asaram Bapu in 2013 rape case; Supreme Court says will consider if his health deteriorates
description: The Supreme Court on Tuesday sought the response of the Rajasthan government to a plea filed by self-styled godman Asaram Bapu challenging the Rajasthan High Court's decision to uphold his conviction for sexually assaulting a minor devotee in Jodhpur in 2013 [Asha Ram @ Ashumal v. State of Rajasthan].A Bench of Justices MM Sundresh and Sheel Nagu added that it is not inclined to grant bail without hearing the State or unless Asaram's health condition clearly warrants it.
